info.title: Crehler Payment Bundle - Check Payment Status
info.description: Store API endpoint for polling payment status. Used after initiating a payment (bank redirect, BLIK) to check whether the transaction has been confirmed by the payment gateway.

post.summary: Check payment status for an order
post.description:
Checks the current payment status for a given order. The endpoint performs a two-tier lookup:
1. Queries the payment gateway API directly for real-time status (if supported by the provider)
2. Falls back to Shopware's order transaction state machine

Designed for polling: call every 3 seconds for up to 120 seconds after payment initiation. Stop polling when status=true (paid) or when both status=false and waiting=false (failed).

403.description: Customer is not logged in and guest checkout is not enabled

orderId.description: UUID of the order to check payment status for.

CheckPaymentStatusResponse.description:
Payment status result. Three possible states:
- status=true, waiting=false → Payment confirmed (stop polling, redirect to success page)
- status=false, waiting=true → Payment pending (continue polling)
- status=false, waiting=false → Payment failed (stop polling, show error)

status.description: True if the payment has been confirmed as paid. False if still pending or failed.

waiting.description: True if the payment is still being processed (continue polling). False if the payment has reached a final state (paid or failed).

failed.description: True if the payment reached a terminal non-paid state (cancelled, declined, failed, chargeback). Convenience flag equal to (status=false AND waiting=false); lets the storefront stop polling and show an error immediately instead of waiting for the timeout.
